'''Quilljayk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], Quilljayk was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Quilljayk returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there.<ref name="TOR" />

Selecting the young [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Flingeld]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], he strove to instill the human with the tenets of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] and teach his student to be accountable for his actions. When the time came for Flingeld to face the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Quilljayk assigned him to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] a massive boulder and retrieve the contents underneath it. When Flingled gave in to frustration, he asked another Padawan to assist him. When the Padawan lifted the boulder for Flingheld, nothing was found underneath.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
Having failed his Master's test, which was truly to admit defeat gracefully, Quilljayk deemed the boy unfit to continue the training and assigned him to work in the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Archives]] as a clerk, never to attain a rank in the Order.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Quilljayk first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
The player(s) have two dialogue choices with Quilljayk:
*Tell Quilljayk that Flingeld was lying about not asking for help, resulting in the latter being sent to the archives, earning the player(s) light side points.<ref name="TOR" />
*Tell Quilljayk that the player(s) volunteered to help him, resulting in the player(s) gaining dark side points and Flingeld gaining a second chance to prove himself.<ref name="TOR" />
